_provenance: Recorded sky2-bench 1.1.0 run on the Sky-2 mini-PC, 1 September 2026. Transcribed into this tool's report schema so `bench.sh --compare` can put the two boxes side by side. It was NOT produced by scripts/asr/bench.py, so only the fields the comparison table reads are filled in.
_conditions: Idle box, no webapp, but Firefox and a few terminals were open. Governor was powersave (untested lever). Stock Parakeet-TDT-0.6b-v2 int8 through sherpa-onnx, greedy decoding, CPU.
label: sky2-2026-09-01

notes: No AVX2 (Elkhart Lake / Tremont): onnxruntime's fast int8 kernels fall back. This is the single largest factor in the 1.535 s and no setting recovers it.
Drift under 1% and a flat 0.48-0.51x real-time factor from 1 s to 30 s: honestly slow rather than thermally unstable.
4 threads was 1.5x slower than 2 -- memory-bandwidth contention, not a scheduling problem.
